criteria.reason: Required mapping has no missing semantics or blocking findings; normalized nonnegative weights independently verified.
Coherent anatomy and face; no new silhouette corruption at rest.
Raised arms retain their motion; skirt now stays seated around hips instead of arm-driven lateral flares.
Elbows bend and hands remain within cuffs; corrected skirt remains seated.
Both knees articulate without visible collapsed/spiked legs or detached feet in supplied sample.
Fixed hands stay attached while wrist diagnostic plays; no claim of finger articulation.
Hair, blossoms, neck bow, cuffs and boots remain visibly attached in sampled views.
Head remains seated and face unobstructed in rest and cheer.
Cheer remains visible; arms/chest motion no longer pulls lateral skirt hems upward.
Textures and matte surface presentation remain coherent; all original material/image bytes unchanged by correction.

remaining_limits: Extra rear blossom remains; exact canonical identity fidelity is not restored by weight correction.
This is a provider rig with an explicitly disclosed local 514-vertex lower-body weight correction, not an unchanged provider rig.
Only original declared sample times and views were reviewed, not every continuous animation frame or an in-engine gameplay test.
Fixed-hand profile has no demonstrated finger/thumb articulation, facial rig, cloth simulation or secondary hair motion.
Low bar is 120px gameplay height. Close-up/high-quality character acceptance is not claimed.
semantic_review.scope: Independent low-bar sampled review of the exact corrected Nami rig, produced by another agent. No continuous-motion or game-engine qualification.
